study type: Prospective, open-label, 2 parallel-group randomized controlled trial
outcome: pregnancy rhinitis symptoms (headache, snoring, insomnia, amount of secretions, turbinate hypertrophy, mucosal congestion/hyperemia)
cohort: Pregnant women affected by pregnancy rhinitis were randomly assigned to receive either sodium hyaluronate treatment or no treatment.
finding: Sodium hyaluronate (SH) treatment significantly reduced the intensity of headache, snoring, insomnia, amount of secretions, turbinate hypertrophy, and mucosal congestion/hyperemia, thereby improving quality of life for pregnant women with rhinitis without reported adverse events.
